theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_c1a_lusin_isClosed
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y] (g : Euclid n → Y) (B : Set (Euclid n)), Measurable g → MeasurableSet B → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ C : Set (Euclid n), C ⊆ B ∧ IsClosed C ∧ ContinuousOn g C ∧ volume (B \ C) < ε
